required_gates.proof: Pinned OS image, kernel, runner trust boundary and operator ownership; records tied to immutable host configuration
Host-enforced default-deny network policy outside disposable child; fixed non-AI outbound attempt shows refusal with policy evidence
External CPU, memory, process count and wall timeout enforcement plus termination of descendants
Restricted read-only inputs and separately bounded writable output; symlink and escape tests
Immutable reviewed commit, manifest hash, checksum verification and capped deterministic artifact retention
No tokens, secrets or ambient credentials inherited by any child; untrusted PRs cannot access privileged host
Missing egress policy, unavailable caps, child timeout, corrupt result, wrong hash and unexpected permissions all independently fail closed
Independent review of host isolation and threat model including container escape and privileged-runner risk
Independent scientific gates met; Marcus separately authorizes exact model command, dataset digest and resource budget

strict_policy: If any gate is unverified, refuse model execution; green CI does not change NO_GO.
